details.method: Before declaring a native editor production goal complete, map each original user workflow to its normal product entry and record every external preconfiguration, fixture substitution and manual host intervention. Require installed user-flow evidence for every completion claim.
details.when: A task promises an editor product workflow while individual mechanisms and sample chains have passed tests.
details.counterexample: A user explicitly requests only a bounded sample or mechanism test; full product coverage is outside that acceptance.
details.trial_plan: Start with configured accounts and CLIs only, exercise setup, parallel production, accepted integration and run/repair through normal editor entry. Reject overall completion if a required step needs private hand-authored fixture configuration or external manual copying; preserve scoped regression success separately.
